mission: Introduce readers to compelling biblical stories, help them understand their meaning, and encourage onward reading of Sacred Scripture. This is not a complete 73-book course.
productIntent: Selected and manageable episodes, not exhaustive book-by-book coverage
Sufficient story context and exact Scripture with the approved Bible editions
Optional longer/full reading through existing native reader
Catholic typological Old-Testament/New-Testament links without overloading the beginner
Narrative and meditative texts combined when they help understanding
nonGoals: Reach 73/73 books in the core guided path
Include one passage per canonical Bible book
Turn every Atlas milestone into a mandatory lesson
Treat multiple citations from one Lectionary family as independent recommendations

candidateClasses.CORE_STORY: A strong narrative, miracle, parable, conversation, or central salvation-history event suitable for the main path
candidateClasses.SUPPORTING_REFLECTION: A short Psalm, wisdom text, prophecy, Gospel or epistle passage illuminating an important story or doctrine
candidateClasses.OPTIONAL_DEEPER_READING: Longer contextual Scripture and related passages reached through the reader
candidateClasses.SKIP_GUIDED_PATH: No mandatory lesson; Scripture remains canonical and discoverable through existing reader
candidateClasses.REVIEW_HOLD: Context, source identification, chapter numbering or liturgical/theological association unresolved

selectionCriteria: Memorable human story with coherent beginnings, action and outcome
Centrality to Christ, salvation history, Catholic doctrine and devotion
Understandable without distorting omitted dialogue, chronology or cause and effect
Important Old Testament figures, Passover, Protoevangelium, prophets, Psalms, wisdom and Song of Songs where they illuminate New Testament texts
Consider Johannine Gospel, letters and Revelation with particular editorial attention, without crowding out other biblical voices
Keep published short/long alternatives and independent publisher evidence as decision support, not minimum votes
A clear invitation to open the full text and read further
allowOmission: Long legal/ritual prescriptions with little role in an introductory narrative journey
Unnecessary dedicated readings to satisfy 73-book coverage
doNotInfer: Skipping a guided reading denies the Catholic canon or its spiritual worth
Old Testament is dispensable: its major narrative and typological anchors are central
An Atlas pin is required for all Psalms, Prophets or Epistles
A publisher's whole-chapter assignment is a short abridgement
readingLayers: Concise context and reason this episode matters (not AI-authored Bible narrative)
Faithful chosen exact Scripture selection after editorial review
Optional extended passage and direct existing-reader full-text link

sourceCuration.sourceIndependence: Count distinct editorial families, not source citations
sourceCuration.nextAction: Review the 151 milestones, proposed subdivisions and supplements by story impact, typology and context; choose a curated, selective core, not all books
